Two Bike Collisions Result in One Death, Several Injured

A road accident occurred in Kawardha where two motorcycles collided, resulting in one fatality. In a separate incident in Katni, two bikes collided while en route to a temple, killing one young man and critically injuring five others. Police are investigating the Kawardha incident.
